name: control-decks/session-lifecycle
description: Open, rename, hand off, refresh, and close tasks.

capabilities.description: Create one new task with a self-contained entry prompt derived from the bound object.
Prepare or perform one resumable task handoff while preserving the bound context and current authority.
Rename the current task from its resolved owner, axis, objective, and emoji.
Refresh the current task summary from the latest accepted context.
Close or archive the current task after preserving the smallest resumable state.
